title: quantum-spacetime
description: The codomain of condensing: the transfinite rung — the value-free amplitude fibration condensing produces from the bit's semantic residue. Is the kernel's transfinite-predication-category (what predicate generates); physically quantum mechanics, a value-free fibration before charge enters. Library: amplitude (value-free cell), quantum (E), mode (Π), cohering (quantum coherence), collapsing (measurement -> classical-spacetime).
